summary: IHG filed a Form 6-K furnishing an interim dividend declaration dated 11 September 2026. The registrant confirmed the pence sterling amount payable for its previously announced 2026 interim dividend of 64.5 US cents per share, set at 47.6 pence per ordinary share using an applicable exchange rate of US$1.3547, based on the three-working-day average of WMR closing mid-point spot rates beginning 8 September 2026. Payment occurs 1 October 2026; shareholders may elect USD instead of GBP. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or risk-arb angle applies.
